name: Badge Action
description: Create a SVG badge using GitHub Actions and GitHub Workflow CPU time (no 3rd parties servers)

label.description: The left label of the badge, usually static.

label-color.description: Hex or named color for the label

status.description: The right status as the badge, usually based on results.

color.description: An array (comma separated) with hex or named colors of the badge value background. More than one creates gradient background.

icon-width.description: Set this if icon is not square

path.description: The file path to store the badge image file. Only output to `badge` action output if undefined.
